slides.title: Match their vessel first
slides.body: Open with your rank and time on their vessel type. "Two contracts as 3rd Officer on tankers."

slides.title: Name one real operation
slides.body: Cargo ops, bunkering, dry dock, a port state inspection. One specific thing you did, in one sentence.

slides.title: Prove you can *join*
slides.body: Say your certificates are valid past their joining date, and when you're available. That's what fills a vacancy.

slides.b: Rank, vessel type, one real operation, valid certificates.

slides.question: Hardest interview question you've been asked?
slides.line: Built at sea by a serving 2nd Officer.
